channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Grant: Theatertreffen International Forum 2027, Berlin: 18-day scholarship for emerging theatre makers (all costs covered, no stipend) (closes 26 Nov)
item.description:
Berliner Festspiele, Theatertreffen, with the Goethe-Institut, Pro Helvetia and partners
Deadline: 26 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: NO CASH STIPEND; listed as a deliberate exception. The scholarship covers all participation costs: festival tickets, travel, Berlin public transport, shared accommodation, catering or a per diem, travel and health insurance and visa fees for those not resident in Berlin. No application fee mentioned.

Around 30 theatre makers at the start of their practice spend the whole of Theatertreffen 2027 in Berlin together: watching the invited productions, taking workshops with artists, joining artist talks and excursions, and meeting the festival director and jury.

Cinedans

ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe, with BBBank and SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe
Deadline: 25 Nov 2026, 13:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 prize if the selected concept is realised, plus EUR 10,000 production funding covering fees and technology. No application fee.

item.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28 (HKD 344,400 a year for up to three years; 400 fellowships, practice-led art PhDs included) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong, with eight Hong Kong universities
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 Hong Kong time
Award: Annual stipend of HKD 344,400 (about USD 44,150) plus a conference and research travel allowance of HKD 14,400 a year, for up to three years (2026/27 rates as published by the RGC). Some universities add top-ups: HKBU lists a HKD 40,000-a-year Elite Scholar Award for three years, a further HKD 20,000 travel top-up, four years of tuition waiver and two years of guaranteed accommodation. 400 fellowships for 2027/28.

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme, run by the Research Grants Council, funds around 400 new full-time PhD students a year at eight Hong Kong universities, in any discipline, including AI, computing and data science programmes and practice-led art research (Hong Kong Baptist University's Academy...

item.description:
Hong Kong International Film Festival Society (HKIFF)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Selection for one of Asia's oldest film festivals and its competitions; prize amounts not stated in the call. Entry fees from 4 November to 31 December 2026: Short Film Competition (under 20 minutes) USD 50 / HKD 390; all other categories USD 80 / HKD 624. Fee waiver for documentaries by directors holding a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card. Fees non-refundable.

The Hong Kong International Film Festival, one of Asia's oldest film festivals, is taking submissions for its 51st edition (16-29 March 2027).

item.description:
Sheffield DocFest
Deadline: 19 Feb 2027
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Selection for the festival programme; award amounts not stated on the entry page. Entry fees: features and mid-length films over 40 minutes GBP 40 early (to 20 November 2026), GBP 48 standard (to 29 January 2027), GBP 58 late (to 19 February 2027); shorts under 40 minutes GBP 30 / GBP 38 / GBP 48 on the same dates (plus VAT as listed). Sheffield DocFest, the UK's leading documentary festival, is open for film entries to its June 2027 edition, for feature, mid-length and short documentaries and non-fiction series.
